title: Beef Burger with Cheddar
summary: Juicy beef burgers topped with melted cheddar, crisp lettuce, and fresh tomato. It’s a classic American dinner that comes together quickly and tastes savoury, sharp, and fresh.
steps: Divide the beef mince into 2 equal portions and shape into burger patties about 2 cm thick. Season both sides with the salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the patties for 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium, or a little longer if you prefer them well done.
In the last minute of cooking, place the cheddar on top of each patty and cover the pan briefly so the cheese melts.
Toast the white bread lightly if you like, then spread ketchup on the bottom halves.
Top each bun with lettuce, tomato slices, and a cheeseburger patty, then add the top halves and serve immediately.
